chunks: It was narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Is the hajj of the camel driver complete or incomplete?” He said: “Complete.”
I said: “Is the hajj of the hired worker complete or incomplete?” He said: “Complete.”

key_terms.الْجَمَّالِ: the camel driver, one who works in transporting people or goods by camel
key_terms.تَامَّةٌ: complete and valid in legal fulfillment
key_terms.حَجَّةُ: the act or instance of hajj being discussed

ai.seo_question: Is the hajj of a camel driver or hired worker considered complete in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the hajj performed by a camel driver and by a hired worker is complete. It indicates the legal validity and completeness of hajj for people engaged in work or service while performing the pilgrimage.
